label: Magazine Spread
description: Asymmetric twelve-column spread: a lede across the text side, a held plate beside it, the body running under both, a closing full-width plate, and a pull quote laid over its trailing edge.

layoutSlots.description: Lede — the opening title block, across the text side of the spread
Body copy (runs down the text column, under the lede and beside the held plate)
Held plate — media beside the lede and the top of the body; stays put while the body scrolls past on wide screens
Closing plate — media across the foot of the spread, laid out two-up
Pull quote — laid over the trailing corner of the closing plate
